title: Trust Tasks — what the co-chair is proposing upstream
lead: The registry (trustoverip/dtgwg-trust-tasks-tf, 635 specs, framework 0.7.0) is admitting external work: process-attestation/0.1 (David Condrey) is merged, and a 28-family series is entering as one categories PR (#672) plus one PR per family (#674 social-recovery is the shape template). These are our proposals against that bar. Everything below is local and untracked in the workbench; PR mechanics are Mitch's.
bar: conventional-commit PR title, feat(<slug>): … — PRs are squash-merged, the title is the changelog entry
payload.schema.json beside every spec.md (the build finds specs by one, the generators by the other)
one PR per family so CODEOWNERS routes by slug; the category enum and website/assets/data.js move together if a category is new (none of ours is)
§4.10 lowerCamelCase for closed-set values and member names; §7.3 item 17 issuedAtRequirement; item 19 maxLength on free text; §12 four Security & Privacy sub-headings
worked examples round-trip verified against an implementation, or say plainly which are not
findings that point back at the registry are welcomed as separate issues
order: understanding family (4 specs) + its ceremony — smallest, first, as our shape template
wait for the maintainer's view of the shape

proposals.proposes: A consent-first join: the joiner offers address and intent, reads the host's gateway terms, proves it understood them in its own words, proposes its own machine-readable privacy terms (IEEE 7012), and the host's acceptance seals a bilateral agreement witnessed outside both parties; scoped, expiring grants follow under it.
proposals.knownOpen: Worked examples are not round-trip verified against an implementation; the LAN ceremony ran as a rite, not as trust-task envelopes.

proposals.proposes: The four steps as a definition under /ceremony/: offer opens, exchange, seal (terminal), grant (optional, up to three rounds); an evidentiary witness role; receipt evidence with host and joiner as recorders; aggregate exposure secret because of the grant.

Know-Your-Agent admission through two gates that are never substitutable: an understanding gate on criteria drawn deterministically from the agent's own submission digest, and a human gate an accountable supervisor records; a bilateral credential closes it, revocation mirrors to every anchor, and status is the authoritative read that anchors only mirror.
proposals.source: docs/design-notes/agent-admission-ceremony.md; Gatehouse KY-A (github.com/mitchuski/kyra_gatehouse) — trust-task bridge with byte-exact canonicalisation parity, 200 checks, 14 e2e beats
proposals.knownOpen: Tier vocabulary and anchor neutrality (design note §8); the prototype plays gate authority and supervisor as one party, the definition separates them.

proposals.proposes: The two-gate rule as a partial order: respond and approve both depend only on apply and never rejoin; issue depends on both and is terminal and compensatable; a denial is a complete enactment; receipt evidence with gate and supervisor as recorders.

One round of the agentprivacy dual-agent loop composed from existing tasks only: process-attestation (the Gap's canonical proposal digest is the artifact, the code-derived seed is the Verifier-supplied challenge), confirm/request and confirm/response (the critic's signed verdict, terminal), and the ceremony receipt as the chronicle. No new task minted.
proposals.knownOpen: Whether process-attestation's disclosure categories can carry the drawn check's answers, or a harness/assay task is needed; whether a policy-engine critic should use task-consent/decision instead of confirm/response.

proposals.proposes: Three registry findings from the proof side: persona/correlation/analyze 1.1 read against records 011/012 (what the analyzer can and cannot establish about issuer-scope linkage); process-attestation's challenge echo read against record 003's transcript binding; trust-ceremony-receipt as the framework-side twin of record 008 route 2 (a completion receipt is a citation the credential does not carry).
X3 show composition and governed bundle profiles, and the credential/artifact wall (a proof show is never completion evidence) as a framework consideration.
proposals.state: drafted 18 July — needs a re-read against framework 0.7.0 (outcome evidence, §7.3 item 20) before it moves
